newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal seen $1.00-$2.00 down on import talk.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal seen $1.00-$2.00 down on import talk.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures were expected to open $1.00 to $2.00 per ton lower Wednesday, under pressure from overnight losses and talk of Brazilian soy imports into the U.S., traders said.
Soyoil futures were seen 0.05 to 0.10 cent per lb lower on expected losses in soybean futures and weakness in world vegetable oil markets, traders said.
Both Malaysian palm oil cash and futures values fell sharply. August futures closed down 17 ringgit.
There is also talk that China is seeking up to 100,000 tonnes of soymeal from South American suppliers, traders said.
In overnight trade, soymeal settled down $2.10 to $2.20 per ton.
